"""Thực nghiệm hồi cứu bổ sung; không chọn lại mô hình theo kết quả test."""

from pathlib import Path
import json
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.compose import ColumnTransformer
from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline
from sklearn.preprocessing import OneHotEncoder, StandardScaler
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestRegressor
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression

BASE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
OUT = BASE / "dashboard_csv"
FEATURES = [
    "dien_tre_1_kw",
    "dien_tre_7_kw",
    "tb_7_ngay_truoc_kw",
    "nhiet_do_truoc_1",
    "nhiet_do_tb_7_truoc",
    "thu",
    "thang",
]


def make_features(daily, threshold):
    """Giữ lịch liên tục; chỉ điền tiến trong ngày ở nguồn Parquet."""
    valid = (
        daily["n"].eq(1440)
        & daily["count"].eq(1440)
        & daily["missing_pct"].le(threshold)
    )
    y = daily["power"].where(valid)
    x = pd.DataFrame(index=daily.index)
    x[FEATURES[0]] = y.shift(1)
    x[FEATURES[1]] = y.shift(7)
    x[FEATURES[2]] = y.shift(1).rolling(7, min_periods=7).mean()
    x[FEATURES[3]] = daily["temperature"].shift(1)
    x[FEATURES[4]] = daily["temperature"].shift(1).rolling(7, min_periods=7).mean()
    x["thu"], x["thang"] = x.index.dayofweek, x.index.month
    return x, y


def model(kind):
    """Giữ nguyên cấu hình chính; không tìm kiếm siêu tham số."""
    numeric = StandardScaler() if kind == "OLS" else "passthrough"
    encoder = OneHotEncoder(
        sparse_output=False, drop="first" if kind == "OLS" else None
    )
    estimator = (
        LinearRegression()
        if kind == "OLS"
        else RandomForestRegressor(
            n_estimators=200, max_depth=5, min_samples_leaf=5, random_state=42
        )
    )
    return Pipeline(
        [
            (
                "preprocess",
                ColumnTransformer(
                    [
                        ("numeric", numeric, FEATURES[:5]),
                        ("calendar", encoder, FEATURES[5:]),
                    ]
                ),
            ),
            ("model", estimator),
        ]
    )


def metrics(y, pred):
    keep = y.notna() & pred.notna()
    err = pred[keep] - y[keep]
    return {
        "so_ngay_cham": int(keep.sum()),
        "MAE_kw": float(err.abs().mean()),
        "RMSE_kw": float(np.sqrt((err**2).mean())),
    }


def save(df, name):
    df.to_csv(OUT / (name + ".csv"), index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")


def main():
    protocol = json.loads((BASE / "quy_tac_bo_sung.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    assert protocol["thresholds"] == [15, 20, 25]
    p = pd.read_parquet(BASE / "data/merged_minute_float32_B3.parquet")
    day = p["datetime"].dt.floor("D")
    daily = (
        p.groupby(day)
        .agg(
            n=("datetime", "size"),
            count=("cong_suat_du_bao_kw", "count"),
            missing_pct=("can_dien_du_bao", "mean"),
            power=("cong_suat_du_bao_kw", "mean"),
            temperature=("apparent_temperature_c", "mean"),
        )
        .asfreq("D")
    )
    daily["missing_pct"] *= 100
    cut_test = int(len(daily) * 0.8)
    cut_val = int(cut_test * 0.8)
    assert len(daily) == 1442
    x, y = make_features(daily, 20)
    train = (np.arange(len(x)) < cut_val) & x.notna().all(axis=1) & y.notna()
    assert train.sum() == 331
    rf = model("RF").fit(x.loc[train], y.loc[train])
    summary = []
    common = []
    detail = []
    for split, idx in [
        ("validation", x.index[cut_val:cut_test]),
        ("test", x.index[cut_test:]),
    ]:
        xx, yy = x.loc[idx], y.loc[idx]
        ready = xx.notna().all(axis=1)
        pred = pd.Series(np.nan, index=idx)
        pred.loc[ready] = rf.predict(xx.loc[ready])
        baseline = xx["dien_tre_7_kw"]
        combined = pred.fillna(baseline)
        fallback = baseline.where(~ready)
        result = pd.DataFrame(
            {
                "ngay": idx,
                "tap": split,
                "nhan_kw": yy,
                "RF": pred,
                "Baseline": baseline,
                "He_thong": combined,
                "nhanh": np.where(
                    ready, "RF", np.where(baseline.notna(), "Baseline du phong", "Dung")
                ),
            }
        )
        detail.append(result)
        for label, pr in [
            ("RF", pred),
            ("Baseline", baseline),
            ("Baseline du phong", fallback),
            ("He thong", combined),
        ]:
            summary.append(
                {
                    "tap": split,
                    "phuong_an": label,
                    "ngay_lich": len(idx),
                    "so_ngay_phat": int(pr.notna().sum()),
                    "ty_le_phat_pct": float(pr.notna().mean() * 100),
                    **metrics(yy, pr),
                }
            )
        joint = pred.notna() & baseline.notna() & yy.notna()
        for label, pr in [("RF", pred), ("Baseline", baseline), ("He thong", combined)]:
            common.append(
                {"tap": split, "phuong_an": label, **metrics(yy.where(joint), pr)}
            )
        old = pd.read_csv(OUT / f"du_bao_{split}.csv")
        assert np.allclose(
            pred.reindex(pd.to_datetime(old.ngay)),
            old["Random Forest"],
            rtol=1e-5,
            atol=1e-7,
        )
    save(pd.DataFrame(summary), "fallback_tong_hop")
    save(pd.DataFrame(common), "fallback_cung_ngay")
    save(pd.concat(detail, ignore_index=True), "fallback_tung_ngay")
    # Độ nhạy chỉ trên train/validation; không đọc kết quả test để chọn ngưỡng.
    sets = {q: make_features(daily.iloc[:cut_test], q) for q in [15, 20, 25]}
    common_idx = daily.index[cut_val:cut_test]
    for xx, yy in sets.values():
        common_idx = common_idx.intersection(
            xx.index[xx.notna().all(axis=1) & yy.notna()]
        )
    sens = []
    for q, (xx, yy) in sets.items():
        tr = (np.arange(len(xx)) < cut_val) & xx.notna().all(axis=1) & yy.notna()
        va = (np.arange(len(xx)) >= cut_val) & xx.notna().all(axis=1) & yy.notna()
        for kind in ["OLS", "RF"]:
            m = model(kind).fit(xx.loc[tr], yy.loc[tr])
            pr = pd.Series(m.predict(xx.loc[va]), index=xx.index[va])
            sens.append(
                {
                    "nguong_pct": q,
                    "mo_hinh": kind,
                    "ngay_train": int(tr.sum()),
                    "ngay_validation": int(va.sum()),
                    "MAE_mau_rieng_kw": metrics(yy, pr)["MAE_kw"],
                    "ngay_chung": len(common_idx),
                    "MAE_cung_ngay_nhan_rieng_kw": metrics(
                        yy.reindex(common_idx), pr.reindex(common_idx)
                    )["MAE_kw"],
                }
            )
    save(pd.DataFrame(sens), "do_nhay_validation")
    # Minh chứng ô thật: 0 hợp lệ, không đọc được, ngoài ngưỡng và chuỗi được chuẩn hóa.
    rawfile = next((BASE / "data/nguon_goc").glob("*CSV1.csv"))
    raw = pd.read_csv(rawfile, sep=";", dtype=str, keep_default_na=False)
    examples = []
    counts = []
    for col, upper in [
        ("Global_active_power", 11),
        ("Sub_metering_1", 90),
        ("Sub_metering_2", 82),
        ("Sub_metering_3", 35),
    ]:
        s = raw[col]
        parsed = pd.to_numeric(
            s.str.replace(r"[^\d,.\-]", "", regex=True).str.replace(
                ",", ".", regex=False
            ),
            errors="coerce",
        )
        masks = {
            "0 hop le": parsed.eq(0),
            "Khong doc duoc": parsed.isna(),
            "Ngoai nguong thu": parsed.notna() & ~parsed.between(0, upper),
            "Chuan hoa chuoi": pd.to_numeric(s, errors="coerce").isna()
            & parsed.between(0, upper),
        }
        counts.append(
            {
                "cot": col,
                "so_0_hop_le": int(masks["0 hop le"].sum()),
                "so_khong_doc_duoc": int(masks["Khong doc duoc"].sum()),
                "so_ngoai_nguong": int(masks["Ngoai nguong thu"].sum()),
            }
        )
        for label, mask in masks.items():
            for i in np.flatnonzero(mask.to_numpy())[:2]:
                examples.append(
                    {
                        "dong_du_lieu_1_based": int(i + 1),
                        "cot": col,
                        "phan_loai": label,
                        "gia_tri_goc": s.iloc[i],
                        "sau_chuan_hoa": parsed.iloc[i],
                        "gia_tri_EDA": p[col].iloc[i],
                        "cong_suat_du_bao_kw": (
                            p["cong_suat_du_bao_kw"].iloc[i]
                            if col == "Global_active_power"
                            else np.nan
                        ),
                    }
                )
    save(pd.DataFrame(examples), "vi_du_lam_sach")
    save(pd.DataFrame(counts), "phan_loai_so_0_va_loi")
    print(pd.DataFrame(summary).to_string(index=False))
    print(pd.DataFrame(sens).to_string(index=False))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
